solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

indicators.note: destroying the word megastore breaks it apart so its letters can be rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A huge tank is wrecking a big out-of-town shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroying' signals that the letters of MEGASTORE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasholder is the huge cylindrical storage vessel for town gas, so it is a large tank.

clue.text: Seen in spring, a memorable match

indicators.note: the answer can be seen sitting inside the run of words spring, a memorable

explanation.surface: A memorable fixture played in the spring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seen in' tells you the answer lies hidden across sprinG A MEmorable.
explanation.definitionFit: A match in sport is a contest, the same thing as a single game.

indicators.note: cooking the word His means mixing its letters up into another order

explanation.surface: Someone's cooking makes the diners feel extremely chilly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' looks like the kitchen activity but is the signal to rearrange the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling shivery means trembling with chill, so it describes being cold.

clue.text: Police force from the Continent, all concluding

indicators.note: all concluding asks for the concluding letter of every one of the words from, the and Continent

explanation.surface: A police force recruited from mainland Europe, everyone wrapping up a case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all concluding' takes the last letters of froM, thE and ContinenT.
explanation.definitionFit: The Met is the usual short name for London's Metropolitan Police force.

definitions.meaning: gentle and kind, as in ... loving care
a formal bid, as when a company puts work out to ...

explanation.surface: A kindly proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: One word is both an adjective for gentle affection and a noun or verb for a formal bid.

clue.text: Quality of TV signal, first class

definitions.meaning: how well a set picks up a broadcast
in British primary schools the class children join first, aged four or five

explanation.surface: A TV picture that comes through superbly well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first class' looks like praise for the picture; in Britain it names the opening year of primary school.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names how clearly a broadcast is picked up and the starting year of English primary school.

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter of the word for book is left off

parts.note: a tome is a large book

explanation.surface: A book about a cat that was never completed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' drops the final E of TOME.
explanation.definitionFit: Tom is the ordinary name for a male of the species, so it is a cat by example.

indicators.note: only part of the words letter sent is read, so the answer is lodged inside them

explanation.surface: A brief letter goes out and is only half looked at.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partially read' points to the hidden run letTER SEnt.
explanation.definitionFit: A terse remark is brief and curt, so it is short.

indicators.note: uniting means the two women are joined side by side

parts.note: two females means two women in a row; the first is a mother, MA
the second of the two women is a lady

explanation.surface: A grievance that brings two women together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two females' as a whole supplies both pieces: a mother and a lady, set side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A malady is an illness, and a complaint is a mild word for an ailment.

indicators.note: behind puts the figure after the word is

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second
ten is a number, a figure

explanation.surface: A second number trails behind and is soaked.
explanation.walkthrough: MO is informal for a moment; 'behind' places the number after 'is'. 'wet' is the verb, to dampen.
explanation.definitionFit: To moisten is to dampen, so it means to make wet.

definitions.meaning: a festive hymn sung at Christmas time

explanation.surface: A girl singing at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a female first name and a seasonal hymn, as sung by carol singers.

clue.text: Broadcast precedes rant in part of magazine

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters of precedes and rant are sown in a new order

explanation.surface: A broadcast comes ahead of a tirade in some publication.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' reads as a programme but is the signal to scatter the letters of the next two words.
explanation.definitionFit: The centre spread is the pair of facing pages in the middle of a magazine.

clue.text: European politician in Noah's temporary home — fun place?

indicators.note: in puts the politician inside the phrase for Noah's home

parts.note: Noah lived on the Ark during the Flood
an MEP is a Member of the European Parliament

explanation.surface: A Euro-MP turns up aboard Noah's vessel; is this a place of entertainment?
explanation.walkthrough: The definite article stays with the Ark, and the politician goes between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme park is an amusement ground with rides, a place for fun.

clue.text: Kind teacher, your perfect educator initially

indicators.note: initially means take the opening letter of each word teacher, your, perfect and educator

explanation.surface: A gentle teacher is your ideal educator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes T, Y, P, E. 'Kind' looks like an adjective for the teacher but is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind is a sort or category, the same as a type.

clue.text: Bird dropping head a short distance

indicators.note: dropping head means losing the first letter of the bird

parts.note: a finch is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A bird's droppings land only a little way off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping head' removes the F of FINCH; the surface suggests bird droppings.
explanation.definitionFit: An inch is a small unit of length, about 2.5 cm, hence a short distance.

clue.text: Get brighter uniform in different parcel

indicators.note: in puts the uniform letter inside the rearranged parcel
different means the letters of parcel are made into another arrangement

parts.note: U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone gets a brighter uniform in another parcel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges PARCEL to CLEARP; 'in' puts U inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: When weather clears up, the sky becomes brighter as clouds go.

definitions.meaning: a sharp ache in the side, as after running
a single loop of thread made by sewing

explanation.surface: A sharp pain, possibly caused by a needle.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sudden side ache and a single pass of thread in sewing.

explanation.surface: Good and bad together.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means evil, and in slang means excellent, so it serves both opposites.

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters of dating and serene are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A quirky man courting calm actresses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eccentric' looks like a description of a person but signals rearranging DATING plus SERENE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragediennes are actresses who specialise in tragic roles.

indicators.note: shimmying is shaking about, so the letters of later are shaken into another order

explanation.surface: Staying quick-witted while dancing later on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shimmying' rearranges LATER.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on the ball is an idiom for being quick and watchful, that is, wide awake.

indicators.note: in puts the left letter inside the shell

parts.note: a pod is the shell of a pea or bean

explanation.surface: A vagrant leaves something inside a shell.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes inside POD. 'Tramp' is the verb, to walk heavily, not a vagrant.
explanation.definitionFit: To plod is to walk slowly and heavily, the same as to tramp.

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, like cheers

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece applauds a Greek figure.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is informal British for thank you, as is 'cheers'.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in that script.

indicators.note: the bird is entering, that is sitting within, the words weakest relationship

explanation.surface: A bird intrudes on the frailest of partnerships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' points to the hidden run weaKEST RELationship.
explanation.definitionFit: The kestrel is a small falcon known for hovering, a bird of prey.

indicators.note: in audition means as heard spoken, so the letter is replaced by a word of the same sound

parts.note: a character is a letter of the alphabet, here the letter written as cee

explanation.surface: The lead role in a casting session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' suggests a lead part; it is the old word for the open ocean. The letter C, spoken, matches the word for the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is a poetic term for the open ocean, as in the Spanish Main.

explanation.surface: A success that struck hard.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a smash success as a noun and struck as a past-tense verb.

parts.note: a kid is a young goat

explanation.surface: A goat dozing gets carried off.
explanation.definitionFit: To be kidnapped is to be seized and carried off by force.
